title: Three Winters and One Short Mask
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：lung　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lung 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the doctor ① filled the lung that no patient in the ward would have measured, and he said the filling was the whole of the winter. The ② lung, meaning the breath itself and not the mask, ran three winters and stayed unmeasured in the book; a lung, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ lung in that ward had the same short mask beside it, and the ④ lung at the far bed, meaning the cough they kept for the children to hear and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lung, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the doctor said the measuring is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lung was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the breath. The ⑥ lung, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; lung, he said, is either something you fill or the only word that means both a breath and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ lung had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short mask. The ⑧ lung of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in January, was one ward and three winters of measuring; lung, he said, is either the cough at the far bed or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lung I remember is the breath measured in the chart, which closed in 1981 and is still measured as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ lung, my mother said in 1983, is the only breath that improves by being measured; every lung, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like a breath. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 肺；肺脏（指病房里每一副旁边的那一副）
B. n. 肺；肺脏（指那副肺本身，与面罩相对）
C. 固定搭配：fill the lung 充盈这一副肺
D. n. 肺；肺脏（指留给孩子们听的那一阵那一副）
E. n. 呼吸之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的肺之事）
F. n. 肺；肺脏（指肺功能图里写到、被测定的的那一副）
G. n. 气力、元气（指一件事里人人都喘却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 元气（抽象总称，指人人都喘却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: filled the lung that no patient in the ward would have measured
The lung, meaning the breath itself and not the mask
the lung at the far bed
the lung was the whole of the matter
the lung had become a line in a chart
The lung of the whole thing
A lung, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: fill the lung 意为“充盈这一副肺”，1974 年那位大夫把病房里没有一位病人肯测定的一副肺做了一遍。
lung 意为“肺；肺脏”，指那副肺本身而不是面罩，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被测定。
lung 意为“肺；肺脏”，指病房里每一副旁边的那一副，每一副旁边都有同一只小小的面罩。
lung 意为“肺；肺脏”，指最远那张床边留给孩子们听的那一阵那一副，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lung 意为“气力、元气”，指一件事里人人都喘却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这口气力就是那件事的全部。
lung 意为“元气”，指人人都喘却无人提起的那样东西而不是那副肺，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lung 意为“肺；肺脏”，指肺功能图里写到、被测定的的那一副，到 1979 年这一副成了肺功能图里的一行。
lung 意为“呼吸之事”，大夫一月写道，整件事的肺之事是一处病房和三个冬天的测定。
lung 意为“肺；肺脏”，我记得的是肺功能图里测定过的那一副，1981 年养好了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一副。
lung 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，肺是唯一会因为被好好测定而变得更好的肺。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年那位大夫充盈了病房里没有一位病人肯测定的一副肺，他说这一遍才是那个冬天的全部。（fill the lung）
那副肺，指的是那副肺本身而不是面罩，经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被测定。（lung）
那处病房里每一副肺旁边都有同一只小小的面罩。（lung）
最远那张床边那副肺，指的是他们留给孩子们听的那一阵那一副，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（lung）
叔叔说这口气力就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那副肺。（lung）
1983 年母亲说，肺是唯一会因为被好好测定而变得更好的肺。（lung）

The lung at the far bed, meaning the cough they kept for the children to hear and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
